purpose: Presentation-only visual hierarchy for Step 6. It may add symbolic/reference graphics and CSS styling, but may not alter Step 5 engineering geometry.

architecturalLanguage.campusBaseline: modern comprehensive research university; restrained, durable, academic
architecturalLanguage.hardRule: Discipline identity is expressed mainly through spatial/material character, not saturated building colors.

information.character: stone + glass + dark metal; modern but not sci-fi

science.character: quiet academic buildings integrated with natural landscape

medical.character: clean, rational, light stone / glass / healing courtyards

architecture.character: model courts / geometric space / spatial experimentation

research.character: university research park with restrained enterprise-modern language

districtPresentation.rule: District rectangles are visual source-control envelopes only, never parcel or cadastral boundaries. North-life has no source xRange and therefore receives a label/green-heart reference only, not an invented district rectangle.

landscapeSystem.framework: one main lake + one water system + two axes + four theme parks + four life green hearts + multiple ponds/courtyards/tree-lined routes
landscapeSystem.lifeGreenHeartCenterRule: derive center from arithmetic centroid of the current residence centers in each formal life area; render 2ha filled inner reference plus 4ha maximum outline; no midpoint area is selected

ceremonialNorthSouth.name: 南北礼仪轴
ceremonialNorthSouth.anchorRule: GATE-SOUTH -> 迎宾广场 -> 明德广场 -> 求真广场 -> CEN-02 -> CEN-01 -> POI-BOYA-LAWN center -> WATER-LAKE-01 center
ceremonialNorthSouth.renderMode: presentation-only polyline/band through frozen source anchors

ecologicalEastWest.name: 东西生态景观轴
ecologicalEastWest.anchorRule: PARK-01 格物园 -> WATER-LAKE-01 -> PARK-02 文心园 -> PARK-04 艺境园

riparianPresentation.rule: visual ecological buffer follows already-frozen water geometry and has no engineering setback meaning

presentation.legendNote: District washes, life-green-heart rings, tree symbols and ecological buffers are presentation/reference graphics; Step 5 engineering coordinates remain authoritative.

hardRules: Do not move, resize or rotate any Step 5 engineering object in Step 6.
Do not create a final parcel boundary where the source only provides a range, center or conceptual landscape relationship.
Do not use saturated discipline colors; maintain the unified warm-gray / brick / neutral-glass / dark-metal campus DNA.
Jiangcheng Blue is an identity accent, not a building-wall color.
Ginkgo Gold is a limited accent and must not be used as a campus-wide fill.
No raster images or external image dependencies are permitted.
